text: Entry 2059 moves MOZ_APP_NAME and MOZ_APP_PROFILE from mail/confvars.sh to imply_option in mail/moz.configure. Its complete diff exactly repeats context-only entry 2046, which was backed out in 2047 with a build-bustage message; the specific cause is unknown. Suite changes are mixed-patch context, not Thunderbird style policy. At the fixed accepted revision, app name still uses imply_option, while profile names vary by Windows/macOS versus other platforms and enterprise. Preserve those actual conditions when changing build identity; do not copy the 2025 lowercase profile value as a current global rule. No configure/build/package test ran; external discussions remain pending.
title: Place Thunderbird app options in moz.configure and recheck profile spelling
